clinician.final_diagnosis: Histopathology confirmed leiomyoma with the tissue composed of interweaving bands of bland smooth muscles with no cell atypia.
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 41-year-old female presented with a five-month history of intermittent right anteromedial thigh pain and urinary frequency and urgency. Initial workup included negative urine culture and cytology (E005). Imaging (Ultrasound E001, CT E002, MRI E003) revealed a bladder mass. Cystoscopy visualized a large mass indenting the right bladder wall, which was mobile on bimanual examination (E004). A transurethral resection biopsy was deferred due to concern for spreading a malignant process. Further workup included an FDG-PET CT, which showed low-grade FDG uptake with no avid nodal or distant metastatic disease (E006). Subsequently, a surgical intervention was performed where the mass was noted intra-operatively to be extramural and adjacent to the right inferolateral bladder wall, and was circumferentially dissected free, avoiding partial cystectomy (E007). Post-operative recovery was uneventful. Histopathology of the resected tissue confirmed leiomyoma, describing the tissue as composed of interweaving bands of bland smooth muscles with no cell atypia (E008).

CT showed a soft-tissue attenuation mass protruding into the bladder lumen, exhibiting equivocal mild lesional enhancement.
MRI demonstrated a heterogeneous bladder tumor appearing intramural, rather than intraluminal.
The mass was mobile on bimanual examination and cystoscopic evaluation visualized a large mass indenting the right bladder wall.
Transurethral resection biopsy was considered but not performed for the concern of spreading a malignant process.
FDG-PET CT showed low-grade FDG uptake with no avid nodal or distant metastatic disease.
Intra-operatively the mass was noted to be extramural and adjacent to the right inferolateral bladder wall. The lesion was circumferentially dissected free and partial cystectomy was avoided.
Histopathology confirmed leiomyoma with the tissue composed of interweaving bands of bland smooth muscles with no cell atypia.
